name: MonarchTableToolbar
title: TableToolbar
wrapsNative: ViewThatFits of an HStack (one line) or a VStack (two lines) holding the app's filter and control views, Text for the result count and MonarchBulkActionBar; search is the app's searchable(text:placement:prompt:)
summary: The bar above a table or list: the filters, the result count and the app's controls (view switcher, column menu, actions); while rows are selected the filters give way to the bulk selection bar.
whenToUse: Above a list or table that can be filtered, counted, switched between views or acted on in bulk, placed with safeAreaInset(edge: .top) or as the first view above the rows.
whenNotToUse: Not for navigation-bar items alone (use .toolbar) and not for search alone (use searchable). For a selection bar without filters use MonarchBulkActionBar.
api: init(resultCount: Int? = nil, selectedCount: Int = 0, totalCount: Int? = nil, bulkActions: [MonarchBulkAction] = [], labels: MonarchTableToolbarLabels = MonarchTableToolbarLabels(), onClearSelection: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder filters: () -> Filters, @ViewBuilder controls: () -> Controls)

init(resultCount: Int? = nil, selectedCount: Int = 0, totalCount: Int? = nil, bulkActions: [MonarchBulkAction] = [], labels: MonarchTableToolbarLabels = MonarchTableToolbarLabels(), onClearSelection: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder controls: () -> Controls) where Filters == EmptyView
struct MonarchTableToolbarLabels { init(toolbar: String? = nil, results: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: resultCount
options.description: Rows that match the search and filters, shown as "N results" and announced when it changes. nil hides the count.

options.name: selectedCount
options.description: Selected rows. While it is above zero (and onClearSelection is set) the bulk selection bar replaces the filters.

options.name: totalCount
options.description: Rows that could be selected, for "3 of 120 selected".

options.name: bulkActions
options.description: Actions on the selected rows, shown in the bulk selection bar.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the spoken name of the bar and the result count text.

options.name: onClearSelection
options.description: Clears the selection. Without it there is no bulk selection bar.

options.name: filters
options.description: Filter controls, laid out in a row that scrolls sideways when it does not fit.

options.name: controls
options.description: Trailing controls: a segmented Picker as the view switcher, a Menu of Toggle items as the column menu, and actions.

states.name: wide
states.description: Filters, then the count and the controls at the trailing edge, on one line.

states.name: narrow
states.description: When one line does not fit, the filters (or the bulk bar) take the first line and the count and controls the second.

states.name: selecting
states.description: With onClearSelection and a selection, MonarchBulkActionBar with the count, the bulk actions and Clear selection replaces the filters; the count and controls stay.

appearance: The bar has no fill of its own and sits on the screen's background. The result count uses the muted text colour with tabular digits; the controls and the bulk bar keep their own Monarch styling in every theme.
platformNotes: The web toolbar contains its own SearchInput. On iOS search belongs to the navigation bar: the app adds searchable(text:placement:prompt:) to the list, which the plan's ".searchable slot" refers to, and the toolbar does not draw a field. The web builds the ViewSwitcher and ColumnMenu from props; on iOS both are native controls (a segmented Picker and a Menu of Toggle items, see view-switcher and column-menu) that the app passes in controls. The web has sm and md sizes; on iOS the controls keep their own sizes. The web keeps focus in the bulk area after Clear selection; on iOS focus follows the system. Android uses the same name and options.
accessibility: The bar is a container named "Table controls" (labels.toolbar).
A change of the result count is announced, for example "12 results".
The bulk selection bar is MonarchBulkActionBar, which announces its own count and reads each action as a button.
The count text scales with Dynamic Type; the layout moves to two lines when one does not fit.
edgeCases: A selection without onClearSelection keeps the filters, as on the web.
Filters wider than the screen scroll sideways instead of wrapping.
A result count of exactly one reads "1 result"; other counts are formatted for the locale ("1,204 results").

examples.title: With DataTable and selection
Filters, and bulk actions while rows are selected
examples.setup:
@State private var selection: Set<String> = ["a", "b"]
@State private var onlyOpen = true
examples.code:
MonarchTableToolbar(
    resultCount: 12,
    selectedCount: selection.count,
    totalCount: 12,
    bulkActions: [MonarchBulkAction(id: "archive", title: "Archive", systemImage: "archivebox") {}],
    onClearSelection: { selection.removeAll() },
    filters: { MonarchTag("Open only", isSelected: $onlyOpen) },
    controls: { MonarchButton("New", systemImage: "plus", variant: .primary, size: .sm) {} }
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web preview is 686 px wide, so the results count, view switch and actions share one row and the four columns fit. A phone is 400 pt wide, so the count and the actions wrap and the table scrolls sideways; the data, tones and order are the same.
parityExceptions.convention: adaptive layout: a phone wraps a toolbar and scrolls a wide table (HIG: Layout)
